english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for physical or organizational separation.
This is the direct noun for the state or degree of things moving apart, especially in written or technical descriptions.
Use this as the all-purpose noun for the act or condition of things or people being separated.

examples.english: This detachment was carried out to facilitate transport.
examples.traditional: 呢次分離係為咗方便運送。
